improvements.title: 意见回填 7->N 条数守恒并纠正五字段缺口误判
improvements.change: opinion_dispositions 覆盖 shift-W48-resume11-20261123T142455Z/opinions.json 的 7 个 opinion_id 及本轮已落意见，逐条 state=consumed|rejected|deferred、owner_seat、reason、evidence_ref、due；cos-1/coo-1 五字段已齐，禁以『五字段缺口』为由 deferred；items_consumed/digest_rate 由表实算，新增 refill{prior_n,carried_n,consumed_n}。

improvements.rollback: 改前 cp close.json close.pre-digest-cho.json 并记 sha256；失败恢复副本，保持 deferred 原状，不改 opinions.json、不重发通知。

improvements.title: close/manifest/notify/verify 单一 run_state 与 fail-closed
improvements.change: 回填 verify.run_id=shift-W48-resume12-20261123T151900Z、strict_mode=true，5 项 checks 逐项写非空 reasons/实测值，新增 run_id_consistency/check_time_order/dce_execution；close.run_state=partial 时 manifest.stages['close.json']=blocked、manifest.run_state 与 notify_done.run_state 同源 close.json#/run_state，notify 不得 status=sent；score.json 外层 verdict 与内层 score.verdict 一致，未判时 pending。
